name: vm
help: Manage Linux or Windows virtual machines.

groups.name: vmss
groups.help: Manage groupings of virtual machines in an Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set (VMSS).

commands.name: create
commands.help: Create an Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set. For an end-to-end tutorial, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machine-scale-sets/virtual-machine-scale-sets-linux-create-cli.

examples.name: Create a Windows VM scale set with 5 instances, a load balancer, a public IP address, a 2GB data disk and 40GB OS disk.
examples.text: az vmss create -n MyVmss -g MyResourceGroup --instance-count 5 --image Win2016Datacenter --data-disk-sizes-gb 2 --os-disk-size-gb 40

examples.name: Create a Linux VM scale set with an auto-generated ssh key pair, a public IP address, a DNS entry, an existing load balancer, and an existing virtual network.
examples.text: az vmss create -n MyVmss -g MyResourceGroup --public-ip-address-dns-name my-globally-dns-name --load-balancer MyLoadBalancer --vnet-name MyVnet --subnet MySubnet --image Ubuntu2204 --generate-ssh-keys

examples.name: Create a Linux VM scale set from a custom image using the default existing public SSH key.
examples.text: az vmss create -n MyVmss -g MyResourceGroup --image MyImage

parameters.name: --image
parameters.help: The name of the operating system image as a URN alias, URN, custom image name or ID, or VHD blob URI. In addition, it also supports shared gallery image. Please use the image alias including the version of the distribution you want to use. For example: please use Debian11 instead of Debian. This parameter is required unless using `--attach-os-disk.` Valid URN format: "Publisher:Offer:Sku:Version". For more information, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/linux/cli-ps-findimage

parameters.name: --ssh-key-values
parameters.help: Space-separated list of SSH public keys or public key file paths.

commands.name: deallocate
commands.help: Deallocate VMs within a VMSS.

examples.name: Deallocate VMs within a VMSS.
examples.text: az vmss deallocate --instance-ids 1 --name MyScaleSet --resource-group MyResourceGroup

groups.name: diagnostics
groups.help: Configure the Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set diagnostics extension.

commands.name: get-default-config
commands.help: Show the default config file which defines data to be collected.

commands.name: set
commands.help: Enable diagnostics on a VMSS.

examples.name: Enable diagnostics on a VMSS.
examples.text: az vmss diagnostics set --protected-settings {protected-settings} --resource-group MyResourceGroup --settings '{"commandToExecute": "echo testing"}' --vmss-name MyVmss

groups.name: disk
groups.help: Manage data disks of a VMSS.

commands.name: attach
commands.help: Attach managed data disks to a scale set or its instances.

examples.name: Attach managed data disks to a scale set or its instances.
examples.text: az vmss disk attach --disk {disk} --instance-id 0 --resource-group MyResourceGroup

examples.name: Attach managed data disks of a given size to a scale set or its instances.
examples.text: az vmss disk attach --vmss-name MyVmss --resource-group MyResourceGroup --size-gb 50

commands.name: detach
commands.help: Detach managed data disks from a scale set or its instances.

examples.name: Detach managed data disks from a scale set or its instances.
examples.text: az vmss disk detach --instance-id 0 --lun {lun} --resource-group MyResourceGroup

groups.name: encryption
groups.help: Manage encryption of VMSS. For more information, see: ttps://learn.microsoft.com/azure/security/fundamentals/azure-disk-encryption-vms-vmss

commands.name: disable
commands.help: Disable the encryption on a VMSS with managed disks.

examples.name: disable encryption a VMSS
examples.text: az vmss encryption disable -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm

commands.name: enable
commands.help: Encrypt a VMSS with managed disks. For more information, see: ttps://learn.microsoft.com/azure/security/fundamentals/azure-disk-encryption-vms-vmss

examples.name: encrypt a VM scale set using a key vault in the same resource group
examples.text: az vmss encryption enable -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVmss --disk-encryption-keyvault MyVault

examples.name: Add support for using managed identity to authenticate to customer's keyvault for ADE operation
examples.text: az vmss encryption enable --disk-encryption-keyvault MyVault --name MyVm --resource-group MyResourceGroup --encryption-identity EncryptionIdentity

groups.name: disk
groups.help: Manage data disks of a VM.

commands.name: attach
commands.help: Attach a managed persistent disk to a VM.

commands.name: detach
commands.help: Detach a managed disk from a VM.

groups.name: boot-diagnostics
groups.help: Troubleshoot the startup of an Azure Virtual Machine.

commands.name: disable
commands.help: Disable the boot diagnostics on a VM.

commands.name: enable
commands.help: Enable the boot diagnostics on a VM.

commands.name: get-boot-log
commands.help: Get the boot diagnostics log from a VM.

commands.name: get-boot-log-uris
commands.help: Get SAS URIs for a virtual machine's boot diagnostic logs.

groups.name: diagnostics
groups.help: Configure the Azure Virtual Machine diagnostics extension.

commands.name: get-default-config
commands.help: Get the default configuration settings for a VM.

examples.name: Get the default diagnostics for a Linux VM and override the storage account name and the VM resource ID.
examples.text: az vm diagnostics get-default-config | sed "s#__DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE_ACCOUNT__#MyStorageAccount#g" | sed "s#__VM_OR_VMSS_RESOURCE_ID__#MyVmResourceId#g"

examples.name: Get the default diagnostics for a Windows VM.
examples.text: az vm diagnostics get-default-config --is-windows-os

commands.name: set
commands.help: Configure the Azure VM diagnostics extension.

commands.name: disable
commands.help: Disable disk encryption on the OS disk and/or data disks. Decrypt mounted disks.

commands.name: enable
commands.help: Enable disk encryption on the OS disk and/or data disks. Encrypt mounted disks.

commands.name: show
commands.help: Show encryption status.

commands.name: create
commands.help: Create an Azure Availability Set. For more information, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/availability.

examples.name: Create an availability set.
examples.text: az vm availability-set create -n MyAvSet -g MyResourceGroup --platform-fault-domain-count 2 --platform-update-domain-count 2

commands.name: create
commands.help: Create an Azure Virtual Machine. For an end-to-end tutorial, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/linux/quick-create-cli.

examples.name: Create a default Ubuntu2204 VM with automatic SSH authentication.
examples.text: az vm create -n MyVm -g MyResourceGroup --image Ubuntu2204

examples.name: Create a default RedHat VM with automatic SSH authentication using an image URN.
examples.text: az vm create -n MyVm -g MyResourceGroup --image RedHat:RHEL:7-RAW:7.4.2018010506

examples.name: Create a default Windows Server VM with a private IP address.
examples.text: az vm create -n MyVm -g MyResourceGroup --public-ip-address "" --image Win2012R2Datacenter

examples.name: Create a VM from a custom managed image.
examples.text: az vm create -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --image MyImage

examples.name: Create a VM by attaching to a managed operating system disk.
examples.text: az vm create -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --attach-os-disk MyOsDisk --os-type linux

examples.name: Create a simple Ubuntu Linux VM with a public IP address, DNS entry, two data disks (10GB and 20GB), and then generate RSA ssh key pairs.
examples.text: az vm create -n MyVm -g MyResourceGroup --public-ip-address-dns-name MyUniqueDnsName --image Ubuntu2204 --data-disk-sizes-gb 10 20 --size Standard_DS2_v2 --generate-ssh-keys

parameters.name: --image
parameters.help: The name of the operating system image as a URN alias, URN, custom image name or ID, custom image version ID, or VHD blob URI. In addition, it also supports shared gallery image. Please use the image alias including the version of the distribution you want to use. For example: please use Debian11 instead of Debian. This parameter is required unless using `--attach-os-disk.` Valid URN format: "Publisher:Offer:Sku:Version". For more information, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/linux/cli-ps-findimage

parameters.name: --ssh-key-values
parameters.help: Space-separated list of SSH public keys or public key file paths.

parameters.name: --computer-name
parameters.help: The host OS name of the virtual machine. Defaults to the name of the VM.

commands.name: install-patches
commands.help: Install patches on a VM.

examples.name: Install patches on a windows VM, allowing the maximum amount of time to be 4 hours, and the VM will reboot if required during the software update operation.
examples.text: az vm install-patches -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --maximum-duration PT4H --reboot-setting IfRequired --classifications-to-include-win Critical Security --exclude-kbs-requiring-reboot true

examples.name: Install patches on a linux VM, allowing the maximum amount of time to be 4 hours, and the VM will reboot if required during the software update operation.
examples.text: az vm install-patches -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --maximum-duration PT4H --reboot-setting IfRequired --classifications-to-include-linux Critical

commands.name: auto-shutdown
commands.help: Manage auto-shutdown for VM.

examples.name: Create auto-shutdown schedule for a VM.
examples.text: az vm auto-shutdown -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --time 1730 --email "foo@bar.com" --webhook "https://example.com/"

examples.name: Delete auto-shutdown schedule for a VM.
examples.text: az vm auto-shutdown -g MyResourceGroup -n MyVm --off

commands.name: list-sizes
commands.help: List available sizes for VMs.

examples.name: List the available VM sizes in the West US region.
examples.text: az vm list-sizes -l westus
